entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Ajeet Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Counter affidavit filed today by learned Aga is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
3.

In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the daughter of the informant aged about 30 years was married to the applicant, subsequently on 29.10.2023 an information was given that matrimonial family had hanged her to death.
The post mortem report indicates the cause of death as ante mortem hanging and no other injury apart from the ligature mark are visible on the body of the deceased.
The applicant is the husband of the deceased and has no criminal history and is in custody Nadeem vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

sentences.text:

1 since 01.11.2023.
4. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the post mortem report on record and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that soon before the death, the deceased was subjected to any mental and physical harassment in relation to the demand of dowry coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 01.11.2023 and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Nadeem be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 548 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304-B, 323 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Shahabad, District Hardoi, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 10.7.2024 Arun  Nadeem vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
